title: Molly is cute tho, isn't she?
author: GoldieLocks1776
text:
Doxie moms be like, hang in there, it gets better, but those women are the craziest bitches I know.

So I don’t know what to believe. 

Molly is cute tho, isn’t she?
blurb: Molly, a fluffy long-haired dapple doxie, sits perfectly upright on the couch and gives the camera her most earnest look. Her human has heard mixed things about doxie life, but on one point they're certain: Molly is cute.
